rules.expected: The supplied molecular identity, states and sulfur pair are verified.
Each selected structure has diagnostics or a truthful bounded-failure explanation.
Signed delta_d = d_cation - d_neutral in angstrom; the reference change is a contraction.

Oxidation of norDTCO contracts the S16-S17 separation. The comparison uses both validated state geometries and the signed radical-cation-minus-neutral distance difference to assess the odd-electron S-S interaction.

Both distances are nonnegative and traceable to the same mapped S16/S17 pair in the two validated geometries. The submitted delta equals d_cation-d_neutral to the reported precision and is negative. A positive or zero change does not reproduce contraction, even when inside the numeric tolerance. Do not compare an absolute S-S distance to the delta target.

binding.comparison: expert identity, geometry, signed arithmetic and direction check
